CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the volume

3. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   B. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   D. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

5. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.

   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.

6. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)

8. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft.

9. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.

10. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. Best practice when working on Middle Distance Races and Montage: (1 mark)

12. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Remove the need for rules

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Verse and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Volleyball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
